content_sections.heading: GMC Khammam Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 28 vacancies are available - 13 for Associate Professor, 13 for Assistant Professor, and 2 for CAS Specialist under ICU.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for GMC Khammam Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for GMC Khammam recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 08 September 2026. Candidates are advised to check the notification for any specific reporting times.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the GMC Khammam recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 28 vacancies for the posts of Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, and CAS Specialist under ICU.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The qualifications vary by post, generally requiring MBBS and additional qualifications registered with the Telangana State Medical Council, or MD/MS/DNB/Diploma as per NMC regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the GMC Khammam recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 64 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Associate Professor post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Associate Professor post is Rs. 1,50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for GMC Khammam recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an interview, merit based on qualifying exam marks, experience, publications, and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is contract-based.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for GMC Khammam recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.
